title: Friends with Chronic Illnesses …
excerpt: My friend Andy Barwick lives with chronic illness. This excellent piece advises the rest of us on how to help – and avoid hurting – our friends who struggle to live well with so much working against them. http://www.cnn.com/2012/09/11/health/invisible-chronic-illness/index.htm…
body:
My friend Andy Barwick lives with chronic illness. This excellent piece advises the rest of us on how to help – and avoid hurting – our friends who struggle to live well with so much working against them.

 http://www.cnn.com/2012/09/11/health/invisible-chronic-illness/index.html

Andy’s picture is in the slide show … remember him, and those you know with chronic illnesses – in your prayers.
